definitions.gloss: Nagatanien; the food company famous for instant chazuke
definitions.explanation: A Tokyo food maker founded in 1953, known above all for お{茶漬|ちゃづ}け{海苔|のり} — the instant seasoning packet you pour over rice with hot water — and for its furikake and instant miso soup. Its name is a byword for that whole category of convenient rice seasonings.

examples.japanese: {永谷園|ながたにえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{茶漬|ちゃづ}け→茶漬け：04987_chazuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{夜食|やしょく}→夜食：17161_yashoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{永谷園|ながたにえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{茶漬|ちゃづ}け→茶漬け：04987_chazuke⟧だ。
examples.english: My late-night snack is always Nagatanien chazuke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{永谷園|ながたにえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ふりかけ→ふりかけ：19214_furikake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I sent Nagatanien furikake to a friend living abroad.

notes:
The name combines the family name {永谷|ながたに} with {園|えん}, a suffix traditional in tea-trade shop names — the founder's family is said to descend from the Edo-period developer of ⟦{煎茶|せんちゃ}→煎茶：13407_sencha⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {永谷園|ながたにえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{茶漬|ちゃづ}け→茶漬け：04987_chazuke⟧: Nagatanien instant chazuke, the flagship product
- {永谷園|ながたにえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ふりかけ→ふりかけ：19214_furikake⟧: Nagatanien furikake (rice seasoning)
- {永谷園|ながたにえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{松茸|まつたけ}→松茸：13119_matsutake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{吸|す}い{物|もの}→お吸い物：15773_osuimono⟧: its instant matsutake clear soup, a New Year staple

CULTURAL NOTE:
Mentioning {永谷園|ながたにえん} in conversation usually means the product rather than the company, much the way an English speaker says "Campbell's" for the soup. Its packets are standard emergency-kit and dormitory food.
